species: The aim of this study was to analyze the secretome of a Trichoderma harzianum strain during the mycobiosynthesis process of zinc and iron nanoparticles.
cell_type: To obtain fungal biomass for nanoparticle biosynthesis, two agar discs of 5 mm of mycelia grown on potato dextrose agar (PDA) at 24 °C after 7 days were transferred to Erlenmeyer flasks containing 50 ml of culture broth, according to Consolo et al. (2020).
sample_source: The aim of this study was to analyze the secretome of a Trichoderma harzianum strain during the mycobiosynthesis process of zinc and iron nanoparticles.
age: The cultures were incubated on an orbital shaker at 150 rpm and 24 °C for 5 days. ... immediately transferred to flasks containing 50 ml of sterile double distilled water for 72 h, on an orbital shaker at 150 rpm and 24 °C.
strain: Trichoderma harzianum strain LPSc 1503 from INBIOTEC (Mar del Plata, Argentina) was deposited in the culture collection of the Institute of Botany “Carlos Spegazzini” (La Plata, Argentina).
